label: GO step, committed a2 choice after a common prior trial, early-to-mid episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never at D1 or D2) and only when the policy strongly favors a2 (choice logit < -4.4; model_act==2 covers 100% of activations). Within that set it is gated by episode time (stops firing after about trial 70, peaks at trials 10-60), it almost never fires if the previous trial was rare (or a1), and it prefers high value (7.5-8.1). Precision is low (about 0.34): many confident a2 GO steps with the same observed history stay silent, so the remaining selection depends on hidden-state factors no predicate here captures. Activations are tiny (max 0.002). No observable rule for magnitude was found beyond the stronger lift at the most extreme a2 logits. Uses only observed or model-computed variables (the policy logit and value at GO).
